meta.source: Grid (Hallmark theme): white poster stock, blue-black ink, ultramarine fields, one Swiss red mark. Replaced Midnight & Brass in 2026-10.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The sheet: page background, white poster paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and cards on `bg`, a step darker. No border, no shadow.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The selected segment in a segmented control.
